comment: A known-answer test vector for a signed LASSO webhook delivery.
The secret is a throwaway generated for this file and signs nothing real.
`body` holds the request body as an exact string. Verify against these bytes:
re-serializing the parsed JSON will change them and the signature will not match.
`webhook-timestamp` is fixed in the past on purpose, so a freshness check will
reject this delivery. Test signature correctness and freshness separately.
`data` carries a non-ASCII character deliberately: the signature covers UTF-8
bytes, so a verifier that re-encodes or counts characters fails on it.
